horses.incident_text: Lay in when under pressure in the Home Straight.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Shortly after the start was bumped by PERPETUAL POWER and became unbalanced.  Raced keenly in the early stages when being shifted behind HAILTOTHEVICTORS to obtain cover.  ALL ARE MINE continued to race keenly throughout the early stages.  Sent for sampling post-race.
From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Over the final 250 Metres lay in.
No report.
No report.
Leaving the 1500 Metres blundered when being steadied to obtain a position with cover behind CONSPIRACY WITNESS.
No report.
No report.
Jumped only fairly.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Jumped only fairly.  Z Purton stated that his mount failed to travel during the event, did not respond to his riding in the Home Straight and raced in a disappointing manner.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
No report.

Jumped only fairly and shortly after the start was crowded by ON THE LASH which shifted out.  The performance of PERPETUAL POWER was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, PERPETUAL POWER will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Jumped only fairly.  Held up on the Home Turn.  Approaching the winning post shifted in, resulting in its rider L Ferraris having to stop riding and straighten.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Z Purton stated that the instructions were to endeavour to find an on-pace position and as a result he rode his mount along in the early stages to comply with those instructions.  Trainer B Crawford confirmed the instructions and stated he issued those instructions as ONLY U had been racing back in its races and had found it difficult to make up ground from that position at its previous race starts.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Jumped awkwardly.
From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Passing the winning post C L Chau dropped his left rein.  Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.
When caught wide in the early stages was shifted across behind runners approaching the first turn.

Bounded on jumping.  Y L Chung stated that his mount did not appreciate the "Good to Yielding” track conditions.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Near the 100 Metres was steadied when crowded between CALL TO COMMAND which shifted in slightly and THOUSAND CUPS (Y L Chung) which shifted out.  Y L Chung was advised to exercise more care.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to be a "roarer” which had previously been reported.

From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Throughout the early and middle stages raced keenly and refused to settle.  Near the 500 Metres improved to the inside of YOUNG BRAVO and then raced tight to the inside of YOUNG BRAVO for some distance thereafter when YOUNG BRAVO was racing tight to the inside of MEGA FORCE.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Jumped awkwardly and lost ground.  After the 800 Metres STAR BROSE commenced to improve into a narrow run between SURE JOYFUL and SHARPEN BRIGHT when SHARPEN BRIGHT (M F Poon) shifted out slightly.  Near the 600 Metres SHARPEN BRIGHT then shifted back in, resulting in STAR BROSE having to be checked when crowded between SURE JOYFUL and SHARPEN BRIGHT.  M F Poon was advised in similar circumstances to exercise more care.  Approaching the 300 Metres was hampered when taken wider by YIU CHEUNG VICTORY.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Jumped only fairly.
No report.
Shifted out shortly after the start and was bumped.
Jumped awkwardly.

From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  H Bowman reported that his mount did not appreciate racing in amongst other horses and racing on the track which, whilst still rated as "Good”, had effects of some light rain which had fallen during the meeting.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Bumped on jumping.
A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Jumped awkwardly, shifted in and made contact with YIU CHEUNG VICTORY.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to be a "roarer” which had previously been reported.

After travelling a short distance was bumped by MEGA FORCE.  For some distance after the 500 Metres raced tight between MEGA FORCE and ACE WAR and made contact with both runners.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race revealed that the horse was displaying an irregular heart rhythm.  Before being allowed to race again, YOUNG BRAVO will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

Shortly after the start was bumped by SHARPEN BRIGHT which shifted out.  In the early stages raced keenly and near the 1900 Metres got its head up when being steadied away from SHARPEN BRIGHT.  Near the 500 Metres made contact with YOUNG BRAVO.  When questioned C Y Ho stated that after improving to the outside of SHARPEN BRIGHT near the 700 Metres to commence a forward move his mount then hung in when VIVA TASTE improved to his outside.  He said as a result MEGA FORCE became awkwardly placed on the heels of SHARPEN BRIGHT and was steadied when unable to hold its position between SHARPEN BRIGHT and VIVA TASTE.

horses.short: Must pass veterinary exam before racing again
horses.incident_text: Withdrawn on 3.3.26 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame left fore) and replaced by Standby Declared Starter ACE WAR.  Before being allowed to race again, PACKING HURRICANE will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

blackbook_suggestions.reason: Must pass vet exam before racing again

horses.incident_text: Bumped at the start.  Making the turn near the 1000 Metres lay in towards VIVA BOSS and was then steadied to avoid VIVA BOSS when that runner shifted out slightly.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.

Near the 800 Metres was shifted to the outside of SKY CAP (D B McMonagle) and bumped VIVA BOSS when SKY CAP shifted in when not quite clear.  D B McMonagle was advised to ensure he is sufficiently clear when shifting ground.
Jumped only fairly.  From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Lay in in the Home Straight and proved difficult to ride out.

After travelling a short distance became unbalanced when it made contact with GIDDY UP due to both runners shifting ground.  Near the 800 Metres became unbalanced when HOLMES A COURT (H Bowman) shifted to the outside of SKY CAP after being crossed by that runner.  H Bowman was advised to exercise more care.  K C Leung stated that his mount raced greenly and near the 900 Metres, when being crossed by SKY CAP (D B McMonagle), was steadied to avoid that runner when it shifted in when not quite clear.  D B McMonagle was advised to exercise more care.  VIVA BOSS was then obliged to race wide and without cover for the remainder of the event.
After travelling a short distance made contact with VIVA BOSS due to both runners shifting ground.

Bumped on jumping.  After travelling a short distance was eased when racing tight between TACTICAL VICTORY and SKY CAP.  A Atzeni stated that he was instructed to ride the horse in a conservative manner in the early stages as the horse had not been finishing its races off when racing in an on-pace position.  Trainer K W Lui confirmed the instructions issued.

Near the 300 Metres raced tight between VIVA BOSS and GENIUS BABY which shifted out to improve.  A Badel stated that his mount jumped only fairly, shifted in and made contact with GAMEPLAYER ELITE and then settled slightly further back than anticipated.  He said in the Home Straight STAR PERFORMER did not respond to his riding.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to be lame in its right front leg and an endoscopic examination also showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse’s trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, STAR PERFORMER will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.

Bumped on jumping.  J Orman stated that over the concluding stages his mount gave ground quickly but he could offer no excuse for the manner in which it weakened.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

horses.short: Must pass veterinary exam before racing again
horses.incident_text: Was examined by the Veterinary Officer after arriving at the Start and found to be lame in its right front leg.  Acting on veterinary advice that the horse was not suitable to race GRAND MASTERMIND was withdrawn by order of the Stewards.  Before being allowed to race again, GRAND MASTERMIND will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

horses.short: Must pass veterinary exam before racing again
horses.incident_text: Withdrawn on 3.3.26 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame left hind) and replaced by Standby Declared Starter ETERNAL RICHNESS.  Before being allowed to race again, FALCON HUNTER will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

Shifted out on jumping and made heavy contact with YEE CHEONG SPIRIT.

Jumped only fairly, shifted in and made contact with RISING ELITE.  In the early and middle stages raced keenly.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

A Badel stated that from a wide barrier he was instructed to ride the horse in a conservative manner in the early stages.  He added after settling back in the field TACTICAL COMMAND found it difficult to make up ground in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Bumped on jumping.
In the early and middle stages raced keenly and lay out making the first turn.  Throughout the middle stages got its head up when it refused to settle.

From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.

Y L Chung could offer no excuse for his mount’s disappointing performance.  Trainer D Eustace advised he had been pleased with the horse leading into tonight’s race but could offer no explanation for the disappointing performance.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of SPORTS LEGEND was considered disappointing as compared to its previous race starts.  Before being allowed to race again, SPORTS LEGEND will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.  Sent for sampling post-race.

R Kingscote stated that he was asked to hold an on-pace position.  He said after commencing well he was able to race outside the lead but his mount failed to respond to his riding in the Home Straight.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Shifted out at the start and made contact with KOLACHI.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.

Jumped awkwardly and made contact with the right side of the starting gate.
From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Fractious in the Parade Ring and made contact with a rail.  Was examined after arriving at the Start and found suitable to race.  Bumped on jumping.  H Bentley reported that his mount raced too keenly throughout the early and middle stages and as a result could not finish the race off in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

J Orman stated that the instructions were to go forward.  He said when his mount jumped only fairly and then was crowded shortly after the start he was obliged to shift NORTHERN BEAST behind runners in the early stages.  He added after settling back in the field his mount failed to respond to his riding when asked to improve in the Home Straight.  Trainer D J Hall confirmed the instructions were to go forward.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Jumped awkwardly.  From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Raced keenly in the early stages and for some distance near the 1000 Metres was steadied to avoid CALIFORNIA MOXIE.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Bumped on jumping.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
Lay in making the first turn and made contact with SPICY GOLD.  Approaching the 100 Metres raced in restricted room between METRO POWER and PEGAS.

Lay in in the Home Straight.  Over the concluding stages was awkwardly placed near STORMING DRAGON when it continued to lay in.  As a consequence LUCKY PLANET could not be ridden out to the finish of the race.  M F Poon stated that the instructions were to go forward and lead if possible.  He said LUCKY PLANET was standing awkwardly in the starting gates and as a result was slow to begin.  He said this resulted in LUCKY PLANET settling further back in the field than intended.
No report.

A Badel stated that from the outside barrier he was obliged to settle further back in the field.  He said in the Home Straight his mount found it difficult to make up ground from that position.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Jumped only fairly and then was bumped shortly after the start.

Jumped awkwardly, made contact with the left side of the starting gate and became unbalanced.  SPICY GOLD then shifted out and made contact with STORMING DRAGON.  Making the first turn passing the 1100 Metres raced tight to the inside of WINGS OF WAR which lay in despite the efforts of its rider.  D B McMonagle stated that the horse failed to respond to his riding in the Home Straight and could not offer any explanation for the horse’s performance.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Sent for sampling post-race.

Approaching the 300 Metres improved to the outside of CORLEONE.  A short distance later CORLEONE lay out, resulting in it making contact with SAMARKAND near the 250 Metres and taking SAMARKAND wider.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Approaching the 150 Metres was bumped by SILVERY BREEZE when that runner was shifted to the inside of CORLEONE to obtain clear running. A Atzeni was warned for using the whip on consecutive occasions in 2 consecutive strides near the 200 Metres.
Approaching the 150 Metres was shifted to the inside of CORLEONE to obtain clear running and made contact with SUPER UNICORN.  Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.
After the 250 Metres was bumped by SAMARKAND.
Shifted out on jumping and made contact with A AMERIC TE SPECSO.  Near the 1500 Metres was steadied to avoid VIVA GRACIOUSNESS.

Jumped awkwardly and shifted out at the start.  Lay out in the Home Straight and near the 250 Metres shifted out and made contact with SAMARKAND.  E C W Wong stated that from a wide barrier he was obliged to make use of his mount in the early stages to go forward and lead.  He added that, in his opinion, CORLEONE raced best when able to obtain a position with cover as it did at its most recent win on 4 February 2026.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A Badel could offer no explanation for the horse’s disappointing performance.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Was crowded on jumping by CHILL KAKA which shifted out.

Jumped only fairly and then was bumped by CORLEONE which shifted out.  From the 800 Metres raced wide and without cover.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
